currentParagraphText: “That’s fair,” the elf agreed, though she did look a bit disappointed. Jake guessed her plan had been to look into Jake using whatever he gave her to figure out who exactly he was. Additionally, Artemis had told him that it was actually pretty common for gods to bless people based on recommendations from those they had already blessed, and Jake could totally see a world where the elf was trying to figure out if Jake could potentially be interested in having Artemis bless him.
